content: As shown in Figure 2 , we construct ICD-9 tree for diagnosis and ATC tree for medication using the same structure. Here the direction of arrow shows the information flow where ancestor nodes can get information from their direct children (in stage 1) and similarly leaf nodes can get information from their connected ancestors (in stage 2).
